paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: PaLM 540B outperforms prior state-of-the-art results on 24 of 29 English benchmarks in the 1-shot setting and 28 of 29 tasks in the few-shot setting.

evidence.quote: PaLM 540B outperforms prior SOTA on 24 of the 29 task in the 1-shot setting and 28 of the 29 tasks in the few-shot setting.
